detailed_description:
Hand-painted 1990s Madhouse noir cel animation, London, 1886, thin fog, haze, sun from the left, shadow.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:07. The shot opens on a medium shot on the blistered door in its recess as a ragged tramp crouched on its top step strikes a match on its stained panel. The camera is on the pavement at head height, three paces from the steps; low sun from the LEFT. At the first frame the focus of the picture is a ragged tramp crouched whole in the door recess at the CENTRE, his patched brown coat, his knees and his boots on the top step, a battered cap pulled low, his raised arm striking a match on the stained door panel beside the bright brass keyhole plate. Three worn stone steps fill the BOTTOM third; the blind plaster wall fills the TOP third above the door. The camera pulls back from the crouching tramp, widening to show the whole door and its blind wall across the whole shot as the tramp drags the match along the panel, from 00:00 to 00:04. At 00:04 the flame flares and smokes beside the keyhole, and the movement continues to the last frame of the shot. By 00:07 the camera is pulling back through the last frame, and the action continues with it, and the whole blistered door at the CENTRE under the blind plaster wall, a fresh black streak on the panel, the match flame at the RIGHT third, the steps in the BOTTOM third.
